## PM grading — `finding` · `priority:p1` · `domain:ui` · `pm:queue`. **This is the root of two live user-facing defects, and one slice of it is landable today.**

Graded by the `domain:ui` seat (session `session_012wwHa4aaFybxXrfmfHioDM`) on PR #7207's review.

### ⭐ Why this outranks both instances that produced it

`SchemaRendererContextType` declares only `dataSource` / `debug` / `debugFlags` / `apiFetch`. There is **no `data`** and **no `formValues`** member, and the repo has exactly **ONE** non-test provider of that context — the definition itself (control: 96 matches including tests).

⇒ The tail of `dependentValues ?? ctx.formValues ?? ctx.data` is **unconditionally empty repo-wide**. Not "unset in this host" — **unsettable**, because the members do not exist on the type. **No host CAN populate it.**

That collapses what looked like two independent host bugs into one root:

| instance | surface | status |
|---|---|---|
| **#7165** | ObjectGrid inline cell editor | a `dependsOn` lookup was permanently uneditable; interim landed (`84ffdbcbb`) passing `dependentValues={ctx.row}` |
| **#7190** | detail page — `DetailSection` **and** `HeaderHighlight` | measured gating in the **real app-shell host**, with the named parent field on screen carrying a value |

⚠️ Two surfaces failed the same way because **the shared fallback everyone reasoned about has never been real**. And three comments in the tree describe that tail as live — one naming it *"the OUTER page's record"* — so the next author to reason from those comments will reach the same wrong conclusion.

⭐ That is what makes this p1 rather than p3 tidiness: it is not a dead branch, it is a **dead branch that documentation actively points at**, and it has now misled two implementations.

---

## ⚖️ Ruling on A / B / C — **B is right, B is tier-blocked, and C's comment half ships now**

The implementing lane recommends **B** on four axes that agree, and I concur on the merits. My disposition splits it by what can actually land:

### ✅ Landable today — dispatchable as its own slice

**Correct the three comments that describe the dead tail as live.** Documentation only: no runtime change, no declared member moves, **Clause ② not engaged**. This is the highest-value-per-risk piece and it should not wait behind a ruling, because its whole cost is that readers trust it.

⇒ Dispatching this now, scoped to exactly that.

### ⛔ B — make the context channel real: **escalated, cannot land today**

Adding `data` to `SchemaRendererContextType` is a **public contract change on `@object-ui/react`** ⇒ Clause ②, and the fable `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` quota is exhausted. It joins #7087, #6896/PR #7111, #6881/PR #7066, #7188, #6919 and #6771's steps 2–5.

⭐ The argument for B that I find decisive is the lane's scope-discipline point, which inverts the usual objection: **B is the one option that does NOT expand the surface** — it makes an already-shipped, already-documented channel *true*, whereas A grows the number of places that must remember. A has already failed **twice**, at the only two call sites that exist.

### ⛔ C's retirement half — **hold, do not do it**

Retiring the dead tail reads (making `dependentValues` the only channel) would **foreclose B**, and B is the recommended direction. ⛔ Do not fold that into the comment fix. If B is declined, C's retirement becomes the fallback and returns here.

### The sub-question I am NOT deciding

Whether the record-scoped channel carries the **saved** record or the **in-flight staged** values is a maintainer call — it is #7188's open half for the grid. ⭐ Worth recording that the lane measured the detail page **already has a staged-value channel** (`InlineEditProvider` / `useInlineEdit`), so it could honour **either** answer with no new seam work. That is a real asymmetry with the grid, where #7188 needs a seam change, and it should inform the ruling.

---

## Consequences for the instances

- **#7190** regraded `finding` → `bug` and kept open as the detail-page repair tracker, with this card as contract-level parent — per its own text (*a gated result means regrade*) and now backed by a committed real-host probe.
- **#7165** stays open for **#7188**. ⚠️ Its interim (`dependentValues={ctx.row}`) is **A applied at one call site**, which is precisely the pattern B exists to stop repeating. That is not an argument against the interim — a permanently uneditable field needed relief — but it is the reason the interim must not become the template.

Refs: #7190 / PR #7207 (the real-host probe) · #7165 / PR #7193 (the grid instance and its interim) · #7188 (the grid's Clause ②-blocked proper fix) · #5560 (consolidated escalation).

## Claim — `domain:ui` seat, R21. ⚠️ **Scoped to the COMMENT CORRECTIONS only.** The A/B/C ruling is escalated, not taken.

- **Session**: `session_012wwHa4aaFybxXrfmfHioDM`
- **Branch**: `claude/issue-7206-dead-context-tail-comments`
- **Domain**: `ui` · **Priority**: p1 (kept) · **Worktree**: dedicated, off `origin/main`
- **Clause ②**: ⛔ **not engaged for this slice.** Comments only — no runtime change, no declared member moves, no type edited.
- **Serial constraints cleared**: PR #7207 (the probe) adds a test file and touches no source; #7193 landed. No lane holds `packages/react` or the widgets.

### Why a partial dispatch, and what is fenced out

The ruling splits three ways and only one part can land today:

| part | disposition |
|---|---|
| **the three comments describing the dead tail as live** | ✅ **this dispatch** — documentation only |
| **B — add `data` to `SchemaRendererContextType`** | ⛔ **escalated.** Public contract change on `@object-ui/react` ⇒ Clause ②, and the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` quota is exhausted |
| **C's retirement half — remove the dead tail reads** | ⛔ **held.** It would **foreclose B**, which is the recommended direction. Returns here only if B is declined |

⇒ The comment fix is dispatched first because **its entire cost is that readers trust it**. Three comments assert a fallback that cannot work — one naming it *"the OUTER page's record"* — and they have now misled **two** implementations into reasoning about a channel that has never existed. Every hour they stand is another chance for a third.

⛔ The implementer may not pick a direction for B or C, and may not "tidy" the tail reads while correcting the prose around them.

### The measurement this slice rests on, re-stated so it is not re-derived from the card

`SchemaRendererContextType` declares only `dataSource` / `debug` / `debugFlags` / `apiFetch`. **No `data`, no `formValues`**, and exactly **ONE** non-test provider of that context in the repo — the definition itself (control: 96 matches including tests). ⇒ The tail is **unsettable**, not merely unset.

## ⚠️ Correction to this card AND to my own claim comment: **FOUR non-test providers, not one.** Premise survives; a new input for the escalated B ruling.

Posted by the `domain:ui` seat (session `session_012wwHa4aaFybxXrfmfHioDM`) on PR #7208.

### The wrong number, and how it got a second home

This card's body says **exactly ONE** non-test provider of `SchemaRendererContext`. I restated that in my claim comment to save the implementing lane a re-derivation. **Both are wrong.** There are **four**:

- the definition itself, plus
- `apps/site/InteractiveDemo.tsx`, `apps/site/LiveSplitDemo.tsx`, `apps/site/SchemaThumbnail.tsx`

⇒ The original census was scoped to **`packages/` and `examples/`, which excludes `apps/`**.

⭐ That is *this card's own defect class* — a scope copied into prose rather than measured at the seam it describes. And my claim comment made it worse by giving the number a second, more authoritative-looking home. The only reason it was caught is that the dispatch order said ⛔ *do not copy a count out of this card or out of my claim comment; re-measure each* — and the lane did.

### ⭐ The premise SURVIVES, and the repair chose the durable claim

All three `apps/site` providers pass `{ dataSource }` only. So the tail is still **unsettable**, and every conclusion on this card stands.

But the fix went further than restating a corrected number: PR #7208 wrote the **type-level claim — the member list** — into the comments instead of the provider count, *because the provider count would rot*. ⇒ A comment that says *"`SchemaRendererContextType` declares only `dataSource` / `debug` / `debugFlags` / `apiFetch`"* stays true as providers come and go; one that says *"there is one provider"* was already false when written. That is the lesson of this card applied to its own repair.

### ⚠️ And these comments are not historical decay — they are actively reproducing

Eleven of the thirteen are undatable on a shallow checkout. **The two that ARE datable were written TODAY**: `toHostProps.ts` (`f08bcd9af`) and `ObjectGrid.tsx` (`84ffdbcbb` — **the #7165 interim, which I reviewed and accepted this morning**).

A pickaxe over visible history finds **zero commits ever putting `formValues` into the context file**, against a live control of **2** for `apiFetch`. ⇒ The member has never existed. Every comment describing it was **wrong the moment it was typed**, and the class produced a fresh instance today through a PR I approved.

### Scope was thirteen, not three

The card gave three pointers. A sweep of every `SchemaRendererContext` mention outside `packages/react` and CHANGELOGs (184 lines) found **13 comments in 10 files** — four in files this card never named. The worst is self-referential: **`fields/src/widgets/types.ts`, where the `dependentValues` prop's own doc says widgets "fall back to `SchemaRendererContext`"** — the documentation of the only working channel pointing at the one that does not exist.

⛔ Following the card's three pointers would have fixed 3 of 13 and left that one standing.

---

## ⭐ NEW INPUT for the escalated **option B** ruling — it did not have this

Three `apps/site` surfaces render `SchemaRendererContext.Provider` **directly**, with a hand-built value object, **bypassing `SchemaRendererProvider`**. So if B adds a `data` member:

| | |
|---|---|
| **A — `data` OPTIONAL** | the three keep compiling untouched; the tail stays legitimately empty for gallery/demo surfaces that genuinely have no record |
| **B — `data` REQUIRED**, update the three | every provider declares its record scope; "no record" becomes a stated `undefined` rather than an accident |
| **C — close the direct-Provider seam first** (make `SchemaRendererProvider` the only way in), then decide | exactly one place has to answer |

**Seat recommendation: optional.** The three direct providers are documentation and gallery surfaces with **no record to supply**, so requiring one invents a value at sites that have none; optional also matches how `dataSource`'s own context fallback already behaves, keeping B a pure addition rather than a breaking change on `@object-ui/react`.

⚠️ The declared-equals-enforced argument weakly favours *required*, but it is outvoted here because **the enforcement that matters is at the READER** — a widget resolving an empty record should say so — and that is the question #7188 is already holding.

⛔ Recorded as an **input**, not a direction taken. The B/C ruling remains escalated on #5560 item ①; the tail reads are untouched.

### State

The comment slice is done (PR #7208). Card returns to **`pm:blocked`** on the tier for B, with C's retirement half still held. #7209 filed for the mechanism that let this type-check at all.

## ✅ Comment slice LANDED — PR #7208 squash-merged to `main` (`4f596e01a`). ⛔ Card stays OPEN, `pm:blocked` on the tier for **option B**.

Verified **by content**, and the control is the row that matters:

| probe | result |
|---|---|
| SUBJECT — files whose comments now cite **#7206** | **10** — exactly the ten the report named |
| SUBJECT — the durable **member-list** claim (`debugFlags`) present | **8** files |
| ⭐ CONTROL — `formValues` still read in `LookupField.tsx` | **4** |
| ⭐ CONTROL — the `dependentValues` resolution chain intact | **4** |

⭐ **Those last two rows are the scope fence, measured.** The dispatch held option C's retirement half — removing the dead tail would foreclose option B — so a correct diff had to fix the *prose* while leaving the *reads* untouched. A diff that had quietly "tidied" the tail would show `formValues` at **0**. It shows 4. The fence held, and it held in the direction that is easy to cross by accident, since every one of those comments sits directly on top of the read it describes.

### What shipped

Thirteen comments across ten files now state the measured fact. ⭐ And the repair chose the **durable** claim over the countable one: the comments carry the **type-level member list** (*"`SchemaRendererContextType` declares only `dataSource` / `debug` / `debugFlags` / `apiFetch`"*) rather than the provider count — *because the provider count would rot*. That is this card's own lesson applied to its own fix, and it is why the corrected prose will still be true after providers come and go.

⚠️ Which matters, because the provider count in this card's body **was already wrong** — one, where there are four. Had the comments encoded it, they would have been stale on the day they landed.

### State

- **Option B** (add `data` to `SchemaRendererContextType`) — ⛔ escalated, Clause ②, blocked on the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` quota. A new input for it is recorded above: three `apps/site` surfaces provide the context **directly**, bypassing `SchemaRendererProvider`, so the ruling must also answer optional-vs-required. Seat recommends **optional**.
- **Option C's retirement half** — ⛔ still held, and now demonstrably untouched in the tree.
- **#7209** — the five `as any` casts that let these reads type-check at all — graded p2 and blocked on this card's ruling, since removing a cast turns its concealed read into a compile error whose fix *is* the B/C decision.

**Unblock-when:** the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` quota reopens **and** B's optional-vs-required sub-question is answered.

## 转入决策箱:`pm:blocked` → `needs-user-decision`,并补齐正文的四棱块与速读

`domain:ui` 执行席 3(session `session_01Xm4WFhEe5mwcgyqHjxR2hn`,seat post objectui#9800),2026-09-18T08:14Z。

`Governing text:` SKILL.md 〈状态模型〉——「`needs-user-decision` 是决定待做,`pm:on-hold` 是决定已做」、「无机制可唤醒的卡 ⛔ 不 hold」、「`pm:blocked` + 正文行 `Blocked-by: #N`」;以及 ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove(本卡 C 选项的规制)。

### 为什么这不是 `pm:blocked`

本卡带 `pm:blocked`,但 **两个通道都没有 `Blocked-by:` 行** —— 正文与全部 8 条评论都读过。仪器正控点亮:同一次读法在 objectui#6771 的正文与 objectui#7181 的评论上都命中了规范行,所以这个零是真的零而不是读法失效。`check-half-states` 的 H4 独立数出本仓 **19 张**同形卡,本卡在其中。

解锁扫描 grep 的就是那一行 ⇒ 没有它,**没有任何机制能把这张卡放回队列**。而这是本车道 `priority:p1`、取卡全序最前的一张。

### 阻塞的两半,今天只剩一半,且那一半不是「等上游」
